judged_text: newGuests.includes(attendee.email) is a case-sensitive membership test against raw user input, so the branch choosing AttendeeScheduledEmail vs AttendeeAddGuestsEmail for new guests can misroute on case differences. adjudication.rationale: In `sendAddGuestsEmails` (packages/emails/email-manager.ts) the logic `if (newGuests.includes(attendee.email))` relies on an exact, case-sensitive string match between `newGuests` (passed from the raw `guests` input in `addGuests.handler.ts`) and `calendarEvent.attendees[*].email` (built from DB values). The diff shows no normalization (e.g., `.toLowerCase()`) on either side, so if attendee emails are stored/returned in a different casing than the user-entered `guests` values, the new-guest detection can be incorrect and the wrong email template could be sent. This is a concrete edge-case risk grounded in the new code, but the diff alone doesn’t prove that casing will differ in practice.
